messages:
Maya P: quick follow-up to the warmup RFC — thinking about a staged approach that blends eager and lazy for cost/latency tradeoffs. wanted to capture concerns before the design doc update.
Oscar H: curious — what's the staging trigger? CPU/GPU mem pressure, or a time-based grace window after model load?
Maya P: proposal: 3 stages — 1) manifest/index-only (cheap) 2) microshard meta + priority hint (medium) 3) full tensor eager (expensive). transitions: time threshold, cold-request rate, and explicit canary pin.
Ravi K: +1 on stages. main worry: IO amplification when many requests touch different microshards in stage 2. HDDs + network-attached storage will blow up cost/latency.
Alina S: we can surface an "estimated io cost" metric per model version. tie it to billing tags so teams see the tradeoff. also need fallback policy for degenerate access patterns.
Maya P: exactly — thinking of a budget token for stage-2 prefetch. e.g., each request gets X prefetch-tokens; tokens consumed cause background promotion of adjacent microshards. keeps steady-state IO bounded.
Oscar H: can you sketch the cost calc? small math helps product see impact.
Maya P: sure. rough pseudo: 
```
# per-request cost estimate
expected_fetches = sum(p_hit_i * shard_size_i for i in touched_shards)
estimated_io_bytes = expected_fetches * avg_read_retries
estimated_cost = estimated_io_bytes / 1e9 * storage_io_price_per_gb
```
Ravi K: that's helpful. add an amplification factor for random access: if fanout>N then multiply by 1.5-3 depending on backend.
Alina S: and attach latencies: tail latency = base_serving + (io_ms_per_gb * estimated_io_bytes). we should prototype with real traces (we have warmup traces in telemetry bucket).
prefetch-bot: FYI: last 7d trace sample for model:redwood-7b shows mean microshard fanout=2.8, median request unique shards=5, p90 latency bump when cold=280ms.
Maya P: good signal. action items: (1) I will add staged state machine + budget tokens to the doc (2) Ravi/Oscar to propose backpressure knobs for stage-2 (3) Alina to map telemetry fields + billing tags we need.
Oscar H: small API note — runtime should expose `warmup_hint(shard_id, urgency)` so route layer can annotate requests. keeps config out of request path.
Ravi K: also think about a fast abort: if prefetch budget depleted, we should deny prefetch and fall back to prioritized streaming read (so caller still gets tokens incrementally).
Alina S: regarding rollout: enable staged warmup behind feature flag per-customer. we want to monitor error budgets + IO cost delta on canaries before org-wide flip.
Maya P: agreed. I'll push an updated doc this afternoon. tagging @product for visibility. :thumbsup:
Oscar H: thanks — will sketch config knobs in a follow-up.
Ravi K: will run a simulation against last 30d traces and share numbers.
Alina S: will add the telemetry schema and mock billing dashboard screenshot to the doc.
Maya P: perfect. closing the loop here. if anyone else wants to weigh in, drop a note and I'll fold into the PR.
